identity.title: AI Use Case: GitHub Copilot – Developer Velocity
identity.strategicStatement: GitHub Copilot is a strategic imperative for EDDNext, accelerating software delivery and modernizing engineering practice across the enterprise.

initiative.overview: POC to evaluate GitHub Copilot Enterprise across EDDNext engineering teams, assessing its ability to close the software delivery-speed gap and modernize how code is written, reviewed, and shipped.
capabilities: AI pair programmer: real-time code completion and whole-function suggestions in the IDE.
Copilot Chat for in-editor Q&A, code explanation, and automated test generation.
Agent mode: autonomously researches the repository, plans changes, and opens pull requests for review.
Enterprise fine-tuning on the organization's private codebase, conventions, and internal libraries.
scope: Pilot with a defined developer cohort on GitHub Enterprise Cloud using managed Copilot accounts.
Establish policy controls, secret scanning, and acceptable-use governance.
Measure velocity and quality metrics, then evaluate results & refine the rollout.

businessValue.description: GitHub Copilot turns everyday coding into an AI-assisted workflow. Controlled studies show up to 55% faster task completion and roughly 75% shorter pull-request cycle time, enabling EDDNext to ship modernization work faster and with higher developer satisfaction.

otherBenefits.heading: Success Metrics
items: Reduction in development cycle time (PR lead time)
Code review turnaround and build success rate

complexity.dependency: Relies on GitHub Enterprise Cloud and managed Copilot licensing.
complexity.complexity: Requires governance guardrails: secret scanning, policy controls, and human review of AI-generated code.
